statement: For general 5-pose, 0-point data, Table 1 reports a zero-dimensional solution set of degree 16 in all eight natural linkage variables. Of these, four have coincident dyads and are degenerate; the remaining twelve ordered solutions give six unlabelled four-bar linkages. The table is obtained with numerical algebraic geometry, and this extraction retains that evidentiary status rather than treating its path enumeration as an independent exact certificate.

answer.text: Table 1 reports 16 ordered polynomial solutions. Only 12 are nondegenerate, representing six linkages.

source.location: §4.1 and Table 1 (author PDF pp.9–10); five-pose interpretation immediately after Table 2

notes:
The raw polynomial degree is not always the count of nondegenerate physical linkages. No certification is claimed by this table.
